description: Read 1-100 photos, field names in snake_case: rating (0 = unrated), flag and color_label in the set_rating_and_flag/set_color_label values, keywords/nested keyword_paths, EXIF, title/caption/headline, GPS latitude/longitude/altitude, IPTC sublocation/city/state_province/country/iso_country_code, copyright and accessibility alt_text/extended_description (omitted when empty); develop settings are read with get_develop_settings. photo_id and related ids are catalog-local strings. is_virtual_copy marks copies; optional virtual_copy holds master_photo_id and copy_name, or a master's copy_photo_ids. Optional folder stack holds position (top=1), is_collapsed, top_photo_id and ordered member_photo_ids.

lens_profile.description: Add lens_profile to each found photo: the lens profile in its saved develop settings, as Lightroom stores it: enabled (a boolean here; get_develop_settings returns the stored LensProfileEnable 0/1), setup (LensDefaults, Auto or Custom), name, filename, embedded, distortion_scale and vignetting_scale (0-200, 100 is the profile's own amount); a key the photo does not carry is left out; a photo with none of them gets {}. A photo whose group could not be read (the read failed, the photo left the catalog meanwhile, or the call got no Develop turn) keeps its metadata and is listed in failed, so the outcome is partial. Reading develop settings waits for the Develop calls before it, as every read of a photo's develop state does; without lens_profile this tool does not wait.

photo_ids.description: 1 to 100 photo IDs or file paths; returns photos in request order; unknown identifiers are not_found. Repeated identifiers produce repeated entries.
